text: The applicant applied to the Committee of Adjustment, Etobicoke-York Panel, (the “Committee”) to convert the existing electronic retail store to a daycare and/or nursey school for the property municipally known as 74 Royal York Road, under the municipal application number A0390/17EYK (the “Application”). The Application seeks variances from the City-wide Zoning By-law 569-2013 and former Etobicoke Zoning Code. On January 11, 2018, the Committee refused the Application, as the minor variances did not meet the Planning Act’s four tests (the “Decision”). In their report, Planning Staff were of the opinion that they would not object to the application subject to the following condition: That there be a maximum of nine (9) on-site staff (including supervisory staff).
